name: Laoghaire, son of Niall

attributes.attribute: a high king of Ireland, son of Niall
in his reign Patrick lit the Beltane fire on Slane Hill

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Laoghaire, the son of Niall of the Nine Hostages, was a high king of Ireland. In his time, Saint Patrick lit the Beltane fire on Slane Hill. When he heard the preaching of Patrick, Laoghaire chose to follow the faith.

okr.objective: Describe the high king Laoghaire and his link to Saint Patrick.
key_results: The source names him son of Niall of the Nine Hostages.
It says Patrick lit the Beltane fire on Slane Hill in his time.
It notes he took up the faith after hearing Patrick.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (Checkmark 2008), s.v. Laoghaire, son of Niall.
